changelog:
- Initial release of power-cad-drafter.
- Auto-generates DXF construction drawings for 10kV and below power distribution projects.
- Extracts and infers design parameters from survey data or sketches.
- Audits designs against company and national power codes, providing detailed Markdown reports.
- Outputs include DXF drawings, inferred design parameters, audit report, and equipment list.
summary: Auto-generate electrical CAD drawings from survey data and auto-audit against power codes
